{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent lag that narrows as dates approach",
    "The gap between model and true outcomes increases from ~1.5 at d+1 to ~2.0 at d+10, then stabilizes at ~1.0-1.5 through d+20",
    "Sentiment turning positive (1.00) correlates with model being too low, while negative sentiment (−0.33 to −0.67) doesn't prevent model from undershooting",
    "Mean reversion is partially captured but model lags behind true price reversals by 1-2 day intervals",
    "Model peaks are consistently below true peaks by 1.5-2.0 units, especially in the first 10-day window",
    "Sentiment momentum (changing from positive to neutral to negative) isn't fully reflected in forecasts",
    "Model appears to over-correct when prices decline, producing bottoms that are 2-3 ticks too low relative to true lows"
] }
